title: Export Subsidy Reforms and Productivity Improvements: The Case of the Indian Textile and Clothing Sector

summary.about: Evaluates whether productivity growth can offset losses from removing Indian textile export subsidies.
summary.audience: Trade ministries, textile firms and industrial-development policymakers.
summary.method: Runs GTAP policy simulations for subsidy removal alone and alongside 3.5% productivity growth. Counterfactual outcomes are evaluated against a calibrated baseline through sectoral output, trade, factor-income, and welfare channels.
summary.insights: Subsidy removal alone reduces Indian welfare, while simultaneous productivity investment turns the result modestly positive. These are scenario-conditioned comparative responses rather than unconditional forecasts.
